{{Quote|Antilles.''"<br />"''A family name ''foul'' with rebel ties.|Birra Seah and Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 8">[[Star Wars (2013) 8|''Star Wars'' (2013) 8]]</ref>}}
The '''Antilles family''' of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] bloodline. Its [[Marriage/Legends|marital]] relation to the [[Fel dynasty|Fel family]] created a unique blending of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] viewpoints.
